title: Recursion in plain English
why_it_matters: Nested data like folders and comment threads needs it.
explanation: Recursion means a function calling itself on a smaller version of the problem. It needs a stopping case, called the base case, or it never ends. Here n === 0 stops the chain. Great for nested data such as folders or replies.
try_it: Write sumTo(n) that adds 1 + 2 + ... + n using recursion.
